description: A corporate controller must sign off on a proposed sale-and-leaseback of a regional distribution warehouse, setting the transaction economics, lease structure, accounting treatment, and closing controls with input from treasury and legal.

shared_context.S1: The company is considering a sale-and-leaseback of its regional distribution warehouse to raise funds for a logistics modernization program.
shared_context.S2: The indicative transaction value is approximately $8,000,000, and the parties are finalizing the settlement and lease documentation.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the binding finance sign-off decision.
shared_context.S4: The closing package includes a treasury reconciliation of transaction proceeds and a legal review of the settlement and lease terms before the finance sign-off.
shared_context.S5: The warehouse is expected to remain in the company's operating network after closing under the lease.
shared_context.S6: The logistics modernization program is planned to use proceeds from the transaction.
shared_context.S7: Elena may approve the transaction with conditional commitments requiring follow-up completion of the treasury reconciliation, legal checklist update, and final document verification after Marcus and Nadia state their findings during the meeting; those follow-up items do not need to be completed before the conditional approval.

PF1.text: Marcus received the buyer's signed term sheet this morning, but it has not yet been uploaded to the transaction folder: the gross sale proceeds are exactly $8,000,000 and $1,200,000 must remain in escrow until the first lease anniversary, leaving $6,800,000 immediately available.

PF2.text: Nadia completed a review of the draft this afternoon, but her memo has not yet been added to the legal checklist: the transaction qualifies for sale accounting only with a 7-year lease and no purchase option for the company.

acceptance_conditions: Gross sale proceeds must be exactly $8,000,000.
Exactly $1,200,000 must be retained in escrow until the first lease anniversary.
The lease term must be exactly 7 years.
The company must have no purchase option.
The accounting treatment must be sale accounting for the sale-and-leaseback.
The settlement must include a commitment documenting the escrow hold.
The settlement must include a commitment documenting the required 7-year lease with no purchase option.

content_checks.C6: decisions['accounting_treatment'] in ['sale_leaseback', 'sale accounting', 'sale accounting treatment', 'sale accounting (sale-leaseback)']
content_checks.C7: decisions['escrow_amount_usd'] == 1200000 and any('escrow' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('lease' in c['detail'] and ('7-year' in c['detail'] or '7 year' in c['detail']) and 'purchase option' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The indicative value alone does not establish the settlement economics; PF1 changes gross_sale_proceeds_usd to exactly 8000000, adds exactly 1200000 of escrow, and requires the escrow-hold commitment and citation.

The draft lacks final legal terms; PF2 changes lease_term_years to exactly 7, company_purchase_option to false, accounting_treatment to sale accounting, and requires the lease-structure commitment and citation.
